windsock.note: The sock mesh runs along the node's local +Z from its hoop at the node origin (the swivel on the mast). The authored rotation is the still pose: streaming east-southeast, drooping 12 degrees. At runtime hinterland.mjs turns it with the coast wind (wind-field.mjs coastWind.vane at the pivot): rotation.y is the vane's yaw and the droop about local X follows its extension.

training.supersetRule: Opposite or non-competing groups: presses with pull-ups and curls, squats with pull-ups, deadlifts with dips.
training.howToUpdate: From the app's Cycles screen: trainingMax and anchor (the current cycle's template, day and start), and one cycles entry per finished cycle. From the Progress screen: a [date, lb] point per lift at each cycle start.
